text:
ryan_support: FYI, enterprise customer in EU submitted a DPA erasure request this AM but the delete job is failing with a KMS auth error for their tenant key. Customer is asking for proof of propagation and an ETA. Can we triage?

jess_sre: got the alert, investigating. which tenant id? any request id from the API?

ryan_support: tenant_id=acme-eu-22, request_id=04f3c9. Error in logs: 
```
ERROR delete-handler: failed to decrypt key for tenant acme-eu-22: KMS HSM handshake error status=403 signature_mismatch
stack: AwsKMSClient::Decrypt -> kms-hsm:handshake
```

oliver_eng: I reproduced a 403 when calling the tenant-specific rewrap endpoint with the tenant CMK. Locally I see latency spikes (~2s) followed by the handshake fail. Posting the reproduce curl: 
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference/v1/tenants/acme-eu-22/keys/rewrap" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}'
```

kevin_infra: HSM vendor team notes occasional signature validation errors during rollover windows. Can you share the exact time window? we have a partial outage window between 2025-11-09T03:12Z-03:26Z recorded.

ryan_support: failure observed at 2025-11-09T03:15:34Z per our logs. Customer called at 03:30 and escalated to legal.

maria_cs: customer asks two things: (1) timeline & whether deletion completed for EU copies, (2) an audit artifact we can hand to their DPO confirming deletion attempts and errors. They need ASAP.

sara_legal: legal hold note: if customer claims a legal hold from their side, that can affect controller obligations. But the DPA erasure flow still requires us to show what we tried to delete. Provide logs and the KMS call traces, and flag any holds. Also need to confirm whether any backups are within retention windows.

jess_sre: I'm attaching what we can provide: request IDs, S3 object delete markers, and KMS request/response IDs. Sample log snippet: 
```
2025-11-09T03:15:34Z tenant=acme-eu-22 request=04f3c9 action=erase status=failed err="kms:403:signature_mismatch" correlation=kms-req-9921
2025-11-09T03:15:34Z kms-req-9921 outbound=handshake.v1 sent=... received=...
```

oliver_eng: for repro we saw increased token refresh latency causing stale signatures on HSM client in the dedicated flow. Quick mitigation: retry loop with fresh token + backoff fixes for most runs. We'll push a short-term mitigation patch to retry 3x.

kevin_infra: vendor confirmed one rewrap attempt failed and a subsequent attempt succeeded at 03:15:58Z. So data plane delete may have retried and completed. Need to correlate S3 delete marker timestamp to be sure.

maria_cs: can we confirm final state so I can reply to customer? if we have a successful rewrap+delete at 03:15:58Z, we'll need to include that timestamp and the audit entries.

jess_sre: scanning storage: object acme-eu-22/user-data/xyz has a delete marker at 2025-11-09T03:16:03Z and lifecycle processing shows no pending copies. I'll assemble an evidence bundle (logs + KMS correlation ids) and drop into the ticket.

sara_legal: once evidence bundle is ready, redact any unrelated tenant ids and include a short statement: what we attempted, why initial attempt failed (KMS handshake), and confirmation of final successful delete. Also call out retention/backups and any legal hold flags.

ryan_support: thanks. I'll message the customer with a high-level summary and tell them we will provide the evidence bundle in 60-90 mins. @sara_legal do we need a template for the statement?

sara_legal: I'll draft a one-paragraph template you can paste. Keep it factual and timestamped. No admissions beyond facts.

audit-bot: Ticket #SUP-10342 updated: evidence_bundle_created by jess_sre at 2025-11-09T04:40:22Z. Attachments: kms_logs.zip, storage_delete_report.csv

maria_cs: shipped reply to customer with timeline and provisional evidence link. Customer acknowledged and asked for confirmation that no sub-processor stored copies outside EU — can someone confirm?

kevin_infra: confirm: all storage buckets for tenant acme-eu-22 are in eu-west-1; no geo-replication to non-EU accounts. I'll include a short statement in the bundle.

oliver_eng: follow-up action items: (1) short-term retry patch (rolled), (2) add circuit-breaker telemetry to catch token refresh delays, (3) run a backfill check for other tenants during vendor rollover windows.

ryan_support: closing loop here. If anything else crops up I'll reopen thread. :thumbsup:
